'''FC Flora U21''' is an Estonian [[association football|football]] team based in [[Tallinn]], Estonia.

It is the reserve team of [[FC Flora|Flora]], and currently plays in [[Esiliiga]]. Reserve teams in Estonia play in the same league system as the senior team, rather than in a reserve team league. They must play at least one level below their main side."}}
